enunciado: You have 12 gelt coins. You want to give some to tzedakah and save the rest in 3 equal piles for later. If you split all 12 coins into 3 equal piles, how many coins are in each pile?
You have 20 gelt coins. First, you put 4 coins in the tzedakah box. Then you split the coins that are left into 4 equal jars to save. How many coins go in each jar?
Your family collected 30 gelt coins for tzedakah tonight. You want to put an equal number of coins into 5 different tzedakah boxes for 5 different causes. How many coins go in each box?
You earned 24 gelt coins from your grandparents and 12 more from your aunt and uncle. You decide to split everything evenly: half for tzedakah, half to save. How many coins go to tzedakah?
